flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{SuspensionProcessingController (staff-revive-suspension), helpers/{PermanentRevivalHelper,TemporaryRevivalHelper,RevivalBaseHelper}}, api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminui pages/Dashboard/Dashboard, utils/data/LinkData, utils/Meta/WorkItem, pages/NoticeUPL (UPL-only endorsement). ocmsadminprivateapi DataHiveUenFinService (work item placeholder). Work item and endorsement for revival: no code
note: Sheet status: No requirement (5 points); no flow deck. Reviving TS-RED and PS works and is immediately final through staff-revive-suspension, with no work item creation, no routing to a supervisor and no endorse step. Similar but not for revival: (1) endorsement in the staff portal is only for UPL decisions (route upl/endorsement, App.tsx:83-85), and the work item payload builder in utils/mapping/NoticeUPL.ts:171-196 is UPL-specific; (2) in ocmsadminprivateapi the DataHive createWorkItemFor* methods that were checked (PRSC and LTVP) are still a PLACEHOLDER (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2920-2924); (3) the Work Items menu in the UI is commented out with an UNCONFIRMED label (LinkData.tsx:396-398); (4) the dashboard (Dashboard.tsx) is empty. There is no supervisor function ID or role in api-authorization.properties; there is no controller for the resources workitem, workitemallocation, workitemnotices whose names are listed in Fapi.d.ts:264-266. No related maintenance ticket. Do not claim.
recommendation: Do not claim. Only the revive step exists; the work item, routing to the supervisor dashboard and the endorsement of the revival are not in the six repos. Ask URA/the team to confirm whether this requirement was dropped (status No requirement).

steps.step: The officer has revived a reduction (TS-RED) or a permanent suspension (PS) in OCMS
steps.detail: POST staff-revive-suspension revives TS (including TS-RED with the amount restored: TemporaryRevivalHelper.java:170-190) and PS (PermanentRevivalHelper.java:187-204) in one synchronous request (SuspensionProcessingController.java:622-664). Function IDs OCMS_APPLY_PS and OCMS_APPLY_REVIVAL may call it (api-authorization.properties:61-67). The completeness details of the revive are in OCMS19.11.

steps.step: After the revival, OCMS creates a work item containing the revived notices
steps.detail: After the revive finishes, the staff-revive-suspension path returns the response directly (SuspensionProcessingController.java:656-664; PermanentRevivalHelper.java:251-255; TemporaryRevivalHelper.java:186-190); no work item service or repository is called. A search for 'workitem', 'work_item', 'work item' in ocmsadminapi finds no code. In ocmsadminprivateapi work item creation exists only for DataHive scenarios and is still a PLACEHOLDER that only writes a log (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2920-2924). Fapi.d.ts:264-266 only lists the resource name workitem in the UI, with no backend controller.

steps.step: The work item is routed to the officer's supervisor dashboard
steps.detail: The staff portal dashboard has no content (Dashboard.tsx:21-31, empty row). The Work Items menu is defined but commented out with an UNCONFIRMED note (LinkData.tsx:170-173, 396-398), the /work-item path is only a constant (WorkItem.ts:1-12) with no Route in App.tsx, and there is no work item allocation to a supervisor in the backend. The routes under upl/ are only for UPL decisions (App.tsx:83-85).

steps.step: The supervisor sees the revived notices and endorses the revival
steps.detail: The only endorsement screen is upl/endorsement (NoticeUPL.EndorseList) for UPL decisions (App.tsx:83-85); the work item payload in NoticeUPL.ts:171-196 is filled with UPL work_ref/type. There is no screen, button or API to endorse a revival. A search for 'endorse' and 'supervisor' in ocmsadminapi finds no revival-related code.

steps.step: Only an authorised supervisor can endorse, and the endorsement result is recorded on the notice
steps.detail: api-authorization.properties has no supervisor or endorse function ID (only OCMS_APPLY_PS and OCMS_APPLY_REVIVAL call staff-revive-suspension, lines 61-67). The revival is stored directly as final in suspended_notice (date_of_revival, reason, remarks, officer: RevivalBaseHelper.java:278-299) with no endorsement or pending column or status.
